actions.title: Deploy Heavy Extrication Cutters to Vehicle 1 & 2
actions.description: Perform roof removal and door spreading to extract trapped non-ambulatory occupants.

actions.title: Establish Advanced Life Support Triage Base
actions.description: Set up Red/Yellow/Green sorting station at Staging Area Alpha.

actions.title: Highway Patrol Traffic Diversion at Exit 41
actions.description: Divert civilian vehicles upstream to preserve shoulder for inbound emergency units.

actions.title: Stage 3 ALS Ambulances & 1 Water Pumper
actions.description: Position response apparatus in ordered queue at staging apron.

actions.title: Issue Initial Press & Emergency Services SITREP
actions.description: Publish factual incident summary to regional trauma network and dispatch.

rationale: Initial Plan v1 synthesized from concurrent assessments across 6 specialized agents. High-impact deceleration collision with multiple potential trapped occupants.
primaryObjective: Rapid extrication, primary casualty triage, and corridor stabilization.
uncertainties: Non-ambulatory victim count pending on-scene responder physical survey.
Live traffic tailback queue length upstream.

actions.title: Establish North Service Road Emergency Corridor
actions.description: Reroute incoming ALS ambulances via Exit 42B North bypass due to confirmed main lane obstruction.

actions.title: Deploy Class B Foam Fire Suppression
actions.description: Suppress active vehicle fire before initiating hydraulic extrication to safeguard victims.

actions.title: Expand Perimeter and Re-triage Red-Tier Casualties
actions.description: Relocate triage area to 150m upwind buffer zone due to thermal and smoke drift.

actions.title: Dispatch Secondary Mutual Aid Pumper Unit
actions.description: Mobilize auxiliary water supply tender to back up primary attack line.

actions.title: Broadcast Urgent Highway Detour SITREP
actions.description: Update traffic advisory radio and navigation services regarding total corridor shutdown.

rationale: Plan v2 triggered by: Initial Flagship Simulation Pipeline Execution. Fire escalation and primary lane blockage necessitate immediate rerouting of ambulances and heavy foam suppression attack.
primaryObjective: Contain active vehicle fire and redirect incoming units via North Service Road corridor.
uncertainties: Structural integrity of burned vehicle compartment before extrication.
Exact clearance time for blocked highway lanes.
approvalNotes: Verified safe staging area with local dispatch.
